project_type: Python 3.12 setuptools project in a parent Git repository; Tiny Aya/PEFT live inference plus CPU pytest suite
language: Python 3.12 with YAML configuration and Markdown experiment reports
build_system: setuptools via lexsi/pyproject.toml. There is no separate documented local build command; GitHub Actions installs python -m pip install -e "./lexsi[dev]" and CPU torch, then runs pytest from lexsi/.

key_patterns: AgentState.log.messages starts with system+user; append_tool_turn adds an assistant tool_calls message and a tool JSON result. messages_for_template converts tool results to user 'Tool result:' turns. routed_policy wraps an inner Policy and route_vector top-1. schema_regen validates same-tool arguments then model callback then heuristic fallback. TrialConfig filters YAML fields into RunSpec. run_live_trial shards tasks, writes eval.json/eval.md through write_report, and records n_tasks/replicas. EvalResult.as_dict explicitly lists numeric aggregate keys.
directory_structure: Repository root contains .github/workflows and the lexsi project. lexsi/actproto contains agent, evaluation, configs, tools, and model code; lexsi/scripts contains CLIs; lexsi/tests contains pytest tests; lexsi/results is gitignored except placeholders; external workflow artifacts live at C:\Users\arian\Github\Hackathons\lexsi\.agents\tasks\plan-2-execution and must never be committed.
